en.q: Do Japanese universities have dorms for international students?
en.a: Many do, but places are limited and often last one year. If the school dorm is full, a share house is the usual no-guarantor backup in Tokyo and other cities.

en.q: What is the cheapest student housing in Tokyo?
en.a: School dorms are usually cheapest to move into. Share houses cost more per month than a far-out dorm but skip key money and a Japanese guarantor. Central Tokyo studios often exceed ¥90,000.

en.q: Can international students rent a share house in Japan without a guarantor?
en.a: Yes. Major share-house operators typically use an in-house contract instead of a personal Japanese guarantor. Private apartments usually still require a guarantor company.

kr.q: 도쿄 유학생 숙소 중 초기비용이 적은 유형은?
kr.a: 학교 기숙사가 입주 비용이 가장 낮은 편입니다. 쉐어하우스는 월세는 더 나와도 예금·보증인이 거의 없습니다. 도심 원룸은 월 9만 엔을 넘는 경우가 많습니다.

kr.q: 유학생이 보증인 없이 쉐어하우스에 들어갈 수 있나요?
kr.a: 주요 쉐어하우스 운영사는 개인 연대보증 대신 자체 계약으로 받는 경우가 많습니다. 일반 원룸은 보증회사 가입이 보통입니다.

en.q: How much does Amazon Prime Student cost in Japan?
en.a: Pricing is lower than regular Prime; compare monthly and annual student plans against how often you ship and stream.

en.q: Who can sign up for Amazon Prime Student in Japan?
en.a: Eligibility depends on Amazon's student verification rules; confirm your student status and account region requirements before subscribing.
